 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DEVAN M. DESAI  Date : 09/04/2025
ORAL ORDER 1.
This application is filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 for condonation of delay of 799 days caused in filing the First Appeal.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr. Kaash K. Thakkar for the applicants and learned advocate Ms. Kirti S. Pathak for respondent No.2.
3.
Learned advocate for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has good case on merits as well as NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1371/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined on law.

It is further submitted that delay caused in preferring the appeal is bonafide delay and applicant had no intention to cause the delay but due to circumstances beyond the control of the applicant, the delay has caused.
It is further submitted that delay may be condoned as there is no intentional delay on the part of the applicants.

It is also further submitted that applicants have stated in the application in paragraph No.28 that they are ready and willing to let go of any benefit accrued on Mir Mangabhai @ Mangal Bhurabhai vs Thakor Chetansinh Hamirji on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114303800/
1 account of delay on the part of the applicants and they shall not claim any interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period, if appellant succeeds in First Appeal.

Under the instructions, he has further submitted that in view of the settled principles of law in the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in case of K. Subbarayadu and others Vs. The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840 and would submit, upon instructions, that considering the law laid down in aforementioned case, applicant are not claiming his their for the interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period,
if appellant succeeds in First Appeal.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions canvassed by the learned advocates for the parties and contentions raised in the application, it is needless to observe that in catena of decisions, the view taken by the NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/1371/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined Hon'ble Supreme Court is, while deciding an application for condonation of delay, the liberal and justice orientated approach needs to be adopted so that the substantive rights of the parties are not defeated only on the ground of delay.
To meet with the equity, delay can be condoned.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicant.
The delay has sufficiently been explained.
Hence, the delay is condoned subject to condition that the claimant/s shall not claim interest upon enhanced compensation, if any, for the period of delay, if succeeds the appeal.
5. With these observations and directions, the present Civil Application stands allowed.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
